headlines.title: 中共中央政治局会议：深化资本市场投融资综合改革，提升资本市场韧性和信心
headlines.summary: 会议强调，要切实筑牢安全屏障。稳定房地产市场，实施好一揽子化债方案，扎实推进地方中小金融机构改革化险、减量提质。深化资本市场投融资综合改革，提升资本市场韧性和信心。深入排查整治各类风险隐患，坚决遏制重特大事故发生。加强对病险水库、江河堤防、山洪和地质灾害危险区、城市低洼易涝点等隐患排查治理，扎实做好防汛应急抢险救灾各项工作，全力维护人民群众生命财产安全。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: A Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee meeting: Deepen comprehensive reforms in capital market investment and financing to enhance market resilience and confidence.
headlines.summary_en: The meeting stressed the need to firmly establish a safety net, stabilize the real estate market, implement a package of debt resolution plans, advance reforms to mitigate risks and improve quality in local small and medium financial institutions, deepen comprehensive reforms in capital market investment and financing to enhance market resilience and confidence, thoroughly investigate and rectify various risks and hazards, resolutely prevent major accidents, strengthen隐患排查 and management of dangerous reservoirs, river embankments, mountain torrents, geological disaster zones, and urban low-lying areas prone to waterlogging, and diligently carry out flood prevention and emergency rescue efforts to safeguard people's lives and property. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 中共中央政治局会议：实施好更加积极的财政政策和适度宽松的货币政策，充分发挥各项存量政策效能

headlines.summary:

headlines.title_zh: 新加坡投资者现已成为香港写字楼资产的最大海外买家
headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际数据显示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产的最大非本地买家群体，受惠于香港写字楼市场低迷期间不良资产价格大幅回调的吸引。鉴于写字楼资产价格仍处低位，未来数月新加坡资金需求预计将保持稳定。

headlines.title: 天晟新材：股价异动，控股股东拟变更及立案调查仍在进行中
headlines.summary: 天晟新材公告，公司股票于2026年7月28日至30日连续3个交易日内日收盘价格涨幅偏离值累计超过30%，属于股票交易异常波动。经核查，公司近期经营情况及内外部经营环境未发生重大变化，但投资者关注的事项包括：公司于2026年2月6日收到中国证监会立案告知书，截至公告日尚未收到最终调查结论；控股股东拟通过协议转让及向特定对象发行股票方式变更，其中协议转让尚需深交所审核及办理过户，定增已获股东会审议通过但尚未向深交所提交申请；此外，公司累计银行账户冻结金额为68.99万元，占净资产1.06%，不影响主要生产经营活动。

headlines.title_en: Tiancheng New Materials: Abnormal stock price movement; controlling shareholder change and investigation are still ongoing.
headlines.summary_en: Tiancheng Xincai announced that its stock price rose cumulatively over 30% in three consecutive trading days from July 28-30, constituting abnormal trading. After verification, the company's recent operations and internal/external environment have not changed significantly, but investors noted: the company received a CSRC investigation notice on February 6, 2026, with no final conclusion yet; the controlling shareholder plans to change via协议转让 and private placement, with the transfer pending SZSE review and the placement approved by shareholders but not yet submitted; company bank accounts frozen amount to 689,900 yuan, 1.06% of net assets, not affecting main operations.

headlines.title: 香港证监会：向经纪行发出限制通知书以冻结与涉嫌首次公开招股欺诈有关的逾1.25亿港元资产

headlines.title_en: SFC: Issues restriction notices to brokerage firms to freeze over HK$125 million in assets linked to suspected IPO fraud.
headlines.summary_en: According to the Hong Kong SFC website, the SFC issued a restriction notice to Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited, prohibiting it from dealing with assets in a client account held by a certain entity, up to HKD 125,247,000. The entity is suspected of involvement in a fraud scheme to create false demand for IPO shares. Futu is not under SFC investigation, and the notice does not affect Futu or its other clients.

headlines.title: 林园投资：部分产品维持原合同约定不再接受申购
headlines.summary: 深圳市林园投资管理有限责任公司发布公告称，169只私募基金产品维持原合同约定不再接受申购，相关产品不再修改基金合同以适配《私募证券投资基金运作指引》的要求，维持原合同条款及投资自由度不变。林园投资解释称，公司产品的投资运作一直坚持适度集中、长期投资的风格，这与《运作指引》中关于组合投资“双25%”限制及债券投资比例限制等条款存在冲突。若强行修改，将造成产品现在或未来被迫调仓，在目前及未来的市场环境下可能对现有持有人利益造成实质损害。自2026年8月1日起，客户持有的产品将不再接受新增申购，产品到期后不展期，按合同约定正常清算。

headlines.title_en: Linyuan Investment: Some products maintain original contract terms and no longer accept subscriptions
headlines.summary_en: Shenzhen Lin Yuan Investment Management Co., Ltd. announced that 169 private fund products will maintain original contract terms and no longer accept subscriptions. Related products will not modify contracts to comply with the 'Private Securities Investment Fund Operational Guidelines', maintaining original terms and investment freedom. The firm explained its investment approach of moderate concentration and long-term holding conflicts with the Guidelines' 'double 25%' portfolio restriction and bond investment limits. Forcing changes could harm existing holders' interests in current and future markets. From August 1, 2026, client products will no longer accept new subscriptions and will not be extended upon maturity, with normal liquidation per contract terms.

headlines.title: 五粮液集团等入股四川长江担保集团，后者增资至约53.6亿元
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月30日讯，天眼查App显示，7月29日，四川长江担保集团有限公司发生工商变更，新增四川省宜宾五粮液集团有限公司、宜宾市产业投资集团有限公司、宜宾市高新投资集团有限公司等为股东，同时，注册资本由约14.1亿人民币增至约53.6亿人民币，增幅约279%。该公司成立于2022年11月，法定代表人为郑智，经营范围含非融资担保服务、自有资金投资的资产管理服务、以自有资金从事投资活动、融资咨询服务、企业管理咨询等。股东信息显示，该公司现由宜宾市财政局及上述新增股东共同持股。

headlines.title_en: Wuliangye Group and others invest in Sichuan Changjiang Guarantee Group, whose registered capital increases to approximately 5.36 billion yuan.
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, July 30 - Tianyancha App shows that on July 29, Sichuan Changjiang Guarantee Group Co., Ltd. underwent industrial and commercial changes, adding shareholders such as Sichuan Yibin Wuliangye Group Co., Ltd., Yibin Industrial Investment Group Co., Ltd., and Yibin High-tech Investment Group Co., Ltd., while increasing registered capital from approx. 1.41 billion yuan to approx. 5.36 billion yuan, a ~279% increase. Established in November 2022, the company is now jointly held by Yibin Finance Bureau and the new shareholders.

headlines.summary_en: The ChiNext ETF (159915) traded 16.3 billion yuan, surpassing its previous intra-year high on July 17, 2026. In July, the ETF saw cumulative net subscriptions of 32.026 billion yuan, with the latest scale at 65.8 billion yuan. The STAR 50 ETF (588000) traded 14.5 billion yuan, marking the third highest intra-year record. In July, the ETF saw cumulative net subscriptions of 38.922 billion yuan, with the latest scale at 86.3 billion yuan.
